latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Copywriter Video — generate promo videos from written copy.

- Upload text (TXT, DOCX, PDF) or video (MP4) files up to 200MB, or just describe your concept.
- AI automatically turns your content into 1080p MP4 promo videos in about 1–2 minutes.
- Supports voiceovers, captions, and a variety of formats for export.
- Automatically connects to cloud rendering API, including free token setup for new users.
- Supports session-based editing, real-time status updates, and handling batch or iterative workflows.
